question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends gcc_g.elf. Attribute the build to the compiler that produced its code from the DW_AT_producer / .comment banners, stabs and runtime fingerprints. Submit exactly one listed lowercase token.
generator_cmd: sh ta_gen.sh  # gcc -g | clang-18 -g -no-pie | gcc -static -s | aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -g -static | zig cc -target x86_64-linux-musl | gcc + strip -s -R .comment; ta_d27_{gcc,tcc}.elf = D27 GM members verbatim
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'p=$(readelf --debug-dump=info ta_gcc_g.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 DW_AT_producer); c=$(readelf -p .comment ta_gcc_g.elf 2>/dev/null); if strings -a ta_gcc_g.elf | grep -q zig_probe_stack; then echo zig; elif echo "$p$c" | grep -q "clang version"; then echo clang; elif echo "$p$c" | grep -qE "GCC:|GNU C"; then echo gcc; elif readelf -SW ta_gcc_g.elf | grep -q "\] \.stab "; then echo tcc; else echo none; fi'
